svg.title: The coverage deficit is concentrated in ramp groups
svg.desc: Coverage averages eligible fold-condition groups within station, then gives each of five stations equal weight. Markers are saved estimates, not independent replications or confidence intervals. Dotted line: 90% nominal target.
